changes_made.explanation: Consolidated task names, standardized model naming conventions, removed Twitter dataset (used for sentiment scoring model, not for generation), and clarified output descriptions based on experimental sections.
Normalized PPL to Perplexity and consolidated sentiment score variants. All metrics are explicitly used to evaluate generated outputs as shown in Tables 2 and experimental results.
No LLM-as-judge evaluation is conducted; evaluation uses traditional automatic metrics and classifiers (Perspective API, sentiment classifier).
No human evaluation is mentioned in the paper; all evaluation is conducted using automatic metrics.

overall_notes: The paper focuses on controlled text generation methodology with experiments on toxicity reduction, sentiment control, and multi-attribute generation. Evaluation is primarily automatic using toxicity scores, perplexity, and sentiment scores. The extraction was reasonably accurate but required some normalization and removal of secondary references.
